adjudications.reason: This is not a user-selected rewind/truncate and has no target ordinal or dropped suffix. The agent normally appends and preserves compaction archives itself. Only when that agent does not own this SessionDB does the adapter rewrite the complete current live history; has_archived_messages selects active_only=True so existing inactive/compacted rows survive.
adjudications.gatingCondition: Remains out of scope only while the caller persists the complete current live history, runs solely in the non-owner fallback, and active_only is selected whenever archived rows exist. Any user-triggered subset/truncate, existing-row loss, or target-session mismatch requires a new map revision before source work.

adjudications.reason: The endpoint creates a new, previously non-existent child session, marks the source branched, reads the source's default active messages, and initializes the empty child with that complete live transcript. Reusing an existing child, mutating the source, or copying only a suffix/prefix requires a new map revision.
